data.scope: Existing active TSH2 finite-file epoch and spectral monitor; software helper repair, stronger source-bound verification and fresh physical replication.

profile.transport: PC PCM over TCP to HPS RAM/PIO; FPGA Y and sparse TSP1 drained back to PC

gates.title: Freeze implementation, registered cases and current evidence identity
required_observables: Named case inventory and selected profile
Run UTC interval, commands, retries and watchdogs
pass_criteria: Exact TSH2 source ID and SOF identity match registration, fitted build and assembly; relevant service/probe identities bound.
Reference fix is separately identified; old expected outputs are preserved and shown unchanged for the baseline.
Every planned case has an execution or explicit nonexecution outcome; failed attempts retained; no denominator shrink.
original_scope_limitations: Only the selected profile is admitted. A source hash alone closes no functional requirement.

gates.title: Repair and independently qualify reference rounding helper
required_observables: Ties and adjacent integers at each supported shift
pass_criteria: The three recorded shift63 failures return -1, 1, 1 after the fix.
Boundary/sign/rounding regressions pass using a specification-derived widened-integer oracle.
Negative checker witnesses reject a changed result and baseline expected artifacts remain byte-identical.
original_scope_limitations: Helper qualification is not all reference-model, dynamic-adapter or normative-vector qualification.

gates.title: Qualify selected static reference vectors and transform anchors
required_observables: Selected complete y/frame/bin/metric comparisons where oracle exposes them
pass_criteria: Known DC/impulse/axis/tie/threshold anchors pass independently.
Every selected full vector matches its immutable artifacts and independent integer construction, including complete output tail.
Report exactly which per-bin, metric and internal-stage observations were checked.
original_scope_limitations: Shared frozen coefficient bytes do not independently prove transcendental coefficient generation.
Selected static vectors do not close T-REF-04 quality bounds, T-REF-05 dynamic adapter or T-REF-06 full normative suite.

gates.title: Execute full-size TSH2 core geometry and exact numerical simulation
pass_criteria: Both full384000_dense0 and full384000 threshold100000000 sparse complete with 384000 accepted inputs, 3001 frames and 384512 Y outputs each. Compare every Y, canonical tap and packet byte.
Reduced-length regressions and mask_threshold_boundaries cover threshold equality, below/above conditions and stalled payloads. Physical G09 separately covers full-size nonzero thresholds.
Signoff simulations do not define SYNTHESIS, have cycle and host deadlines, and report no unexpected error/fatal.
original_scope_limitations: One fixed-length test is not full generic finite-length coverage.
A fault status is not a substitute for every internal overflow/statistic field.

gates.title: Exercise adapter flow, FIFO pressure and allowed reset/clear behavior
required_observables: Active waiting epoch clear and recovery
pass_criteria: Directed cases observe actual handshakes and FIFO boundaries, not just scheduled stimuli.
Normal cases drain exactly; defined negatives raise the expected error without unrelated mutation.
Busy controls and recovery match the active TSH2 epoch-latched contract.
original_scope_limitations: TSH2 fixed epoch configuration is not the original dynamic per-frame commit interface.
Unexercised core reset phases remain open, even when adapter reset tests pass.

gates.title: Qualify active RAM packet exporter under ownership and reset pressure
required_observables: Queue occupancy, concurrent distinct addresses and wrap
pass_criteria: Use the RAM exporter that is source-bound to the actual image.
Exact packet fields/checksum/count/order agree for every completed record; aborted prefixes checked against the intended terminal reason.
Registered queue depths and reset/clear at request/response boundaries execute with independent counters.
original_scope_limitations: Queue-depth alternatives are directed supplemental configurations; the image-specific parameter must be identified.
This sparse TSP1 exporter is not the original WAVE/SPEC64/METRICS/STATUS priority packet system.

gates.title: Qualify the actual runner, observed assertions and scoreboards
pass_criteria: Each checker used for a mandatory gate has a positive witness and a deliberate expected rejection or explicitly bounded qualification.
An unrelated compile failure never counts as a successful negative test.
Unsupported semantics remain BLOCKED_CAPABILITY for the affected claim, not silently suppressed.
Both timeout paths or prior qualified unchanged timeout capability are evidenced and linked.
original_scope_limitations: Full original R-ENV closure is unavailable if any mandatory checker semantics, activation or timeout behavior remain unqualified.

gates.title: Requalify native codec, monitor and host application after reference fix
pass_criteria: Rerun the previously registered native and host regression suites with fresh output directories.
Inputs and returned arrays are checked; DLL build reuse or rebuild is explicitly recorded.
Fake IO and local asset checks are labeled separately from actual board/browser verification.
original_scope_limitations: These tests do not establish live transport concurrency, native browser audio-device behavior or physical hardware safety on their own.

gates.title: Admit the exact physical image, kernel, current boot and service
required_observables: Exact JTAG chain and SOF hash
pass_criteria: Historical boot receipts never admit a new boot.
Before programming: qualified exact chain and bridge reset7 in U-Boot; then source-bound volatile SOF programming with immutable receipt.
Before FPGA MMIO: correct kernel/DT ownership, manager4 and bridge_reset5 verified by the separately qualified system probe.
Qualified probe_build02 reads only allowlisted registers and establishes matching source/geometry and clean IDLE or fully drained DONE.
No competing service/process/listener; only temporary RAM payload and prepared PCM are uploaded; expected outputs stay on PC.
planned_evidence: pre/post system and FPGA probe snapshots
original_scope_limitations: This is active-profile bringup and admission, not original kernel-module/DDR-ring ownership verification or full original AC13.

gates.title: Capture complete fresh monitor and flute matrices on the admitted board
required_observables: Per-request input hash, threshold and monotonic epoch
Service exit and final idle state
pass_criteria: Run all12 frozen monitor records at thresholds0/1e7 with2 repeats each; run frozen flute8s at thresholds0/1e8/1e9/1e10/1e11 with2 repeats each.
Each epoch accepts384000 inputs and produces384512 Y values and3001 frames; compare every sample and packet byte to its registered PC-only gold before the next request.
Strict decode validates sequence/threshold/protection/payload/checksum and each repeat is identical.
Threshold0 complete delay-aligned input identity passes; fresh raw counter snapshots show zero drops/faults and exact completed totals.
Keep all failed/partial captures; finite service exits cleanly and no capture remains active.
original_scope_limitations: Original AC10/AC11 and portions ofAC12 are not exposed by TSH2; complete Y/power packets cannot close the original AC13 artifact bundle.
This is finite-file physical replication; source material is not new independent application data.

gates.title: Recompute monitor quality and duration-matched representation comparison
required_observables: Original-duration prefixes and frozen monitor outputs
Full8s and original support byte counts
pass_criteria: Unchanged monitor runs only on original5s/5.12s support; prefix outputs reproduce the prior frozen result.
All4 natural per-recording frozen numerical quality gates pass; all5 intended persistent synthetic events match with no extra clusters, including control negatives.
Natural event agreement is reported against threshold0, with no fault-diagnosis claim.
Never use padded silence to inflate original-duration byte savings.
original_scope_limitations: These are exploratory engineering tolerances, not externally validated fault labels or AI-quality guarantees.

gates.title: Bind implementation timing evidence to the exact programmed image
required_observables: Vendor calibrated DDR and explicit exceptions
pass_criteria: Source-bound fitted reports and exception dispositions remain hash-valid for the exact unchanged SOF.
Every required active clock/path group has the declared timing evidence; distinguish reanalysis from a new fit/STA execution.
Any unresolved active crossing or timing assumption is listed rather than inferred from functional tests.
planned_evidence: timing reanalysis or fresh STA receipt
original_scope_limitations: STA is not a structural CDC proof, oscillator calibration or physical DDR visibility proof.
No new fit is required merely because a software-only reference helper changes.

gates.title: Audit reproducibility and produce evidence-backed waveform report
required_observables: Final artifact hashes and report links
pass_criteria: Independent audit rehashes exact raw captures, checks all values and reconciles aggregate counts with case-level records.
Plots use fresh capture data and shared scales/alignment; diagrams identify actual locations and do not invent internal-stage timing.
Report states tested revision/profile, unresolved issues, excluded requirements and no complete-project/industrial certification.
Do not infer energy or system speedup from receiver timing, simulation cycle counts or service duration.
original_scope_limitations: Documentation and plots are presentation of evidence, not additional independent functional tests.

gates.title: Broader core arithmetic/geometry/reset coverage
pass_criteria: Execute registered targeted cases where supported and report exact remaining bins.
Reduced/white-box fixtures are labeled with their invariants; do not alter production RTL to force a pass.
original_scope_limitations: Not every broader core case is a mandatory fixed-profile operational test. Original requirements remain open until all their mandatory instances are accepted.

scope_decision_rules: A plan row is not evidence. Each gate is evaluated against fresh immutable receipts and exact registered counts.
Scoped release acceptance requires every mandatory registered-profile gate to have sufficient PASS evidence, no unresolved profile defect and an independently reconciled report.
If any mandatory gate is incomplete, report PARTIAL_VERIFICATION or BLOCKED with its exact missing observations; do not lower the denominator after results.
A bounded waiver or applicability decision must retain original requirement IDs, rationale, limitations and owner/reviewer; it never turns an observed violation into a PASS.
Original project-wide acceptance and original AC13 remain open unless every mandatory original artifact and applicable instance is separately satisfied.
The word industrial is not a certificate. Reliability, safety, continuous operation, environmental tolerance, security and energy/system speed claims need separate evidence.
oracle_limitations: Hash equality to registered expected bytes is exact regression evidence but does not prove an oracle correct by itself.
The independent integer reference qualification covers only its declared primitives, transform anchors and complete selected vectors.
The unchanged fixed-point PC reference, native features, prior physical qualification and strict packet decoder have separate responsibilities and should remain separately labeled.
Reference helper repair must not silently regenerate or replace frozen expectations. Prove unchanged baseline outputs before reusing those expectations.
All natural/synthetic material in this board campaign has been used before; fresh board execution is replication, not a fresh independent application dataset.

physical_observability_limits.available: All384512 signed12 output values can be captured and compared exactly.

physical_observability_limits.missing: Original per-frame statistics rows are not directly emitted by this TSH2 service. Decoded aggregate features are derived powers, not the original frame-stat artifact.
Complete original error/statistics commit-epoch fields and internal overflow/carry flags are not included in the40-byte reply or TSP1 packets.

physical_observability_limits.partial: 129-bin thresholded power values can be reconstructed, with protected DC and threshold policy checked. Original signed complex/preliminary-mask/per-bin fields are not all exposed.

physical_observability_limits.consequence: The58 captures can establish selected-profile physical waveform/packet replication. They do not supply the complete original BRAM y/frame/metric/bin artifact set.
